claims.label: Per Corby Hall Statement Host Reads, Victor Marx Expressed Interest in Owning Fold AR
claims.claim: Per a written statement by Corby Hall that the host reads, Victor Marx expressed interest in acquiring ownership of Fold AR.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Hall's account against Fold AR business records, communications, and any documented acquisition proposals.

claims.label: Per Corby Hall Statement Host Reads, Fold AR Demo Provided to Marx in December 2023
claims.claim: Per a written statement by Corby Hall that the host reads, on or about December 1, 2023, at Victor Marx's request, Hall and Melody drove from Texas to Colorado Springs to provide a demo of the Fold AR at Marx's home range; Marx subsequently requested a signature series rifle.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify travel records, communications, and Fold AR demo logs from December 2023.

claims.label: Per Corby Hall Statement Host Reads, Victor Marx Performed "Retooling Prayer" on Hall and Melody
claims.claim: Per a written statement by Corby Hall that the host reads, Victor Marx performed a ritual he described as a "retooling prayer" on both Melody and Corby Hall during the initial home visit; the host characterizes the practice as confronting demons.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify any witnesses or documentation of the prayer ceremony; characterize the practice independently.

claims.label: Per Corby Hall Statement Host Reads, Victor Marx Married Hall and Melody on January 24, 2024
claims.claim: Per a written statement by Corby Hall that the host reads, on January 24, 2024, Victor Marx married Corby Hall and Melody in his hotel room with several industry friends present.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the marriage through official marriage records.

claims.label: Per Corby Hall Statement Host Reads, All Things Possible Ministries Purchased 5 Fold AR Rifles for Lindale High School
claims.claim: Per a written statement by Corby Hall that the host reads, All Things Possible Ministries purchased five Fold AR weapon systems for Lindale High School in Texas; no further ministry participation was made or offered.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify purchase records with Fold AR and Lindale High School administration.

claims.label: Victor Marx Requested 50 Rifles for Haiti Mission (Late Fall 2024)
claims.claim: Corby Hall's written statement documents that in late fall 2024, Victor Marx stated he needed 50 rifles for a mission to Haiti where he would drop off and leave the firearms; Hall advised that this would constitute illegal exporting.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify any related communications, travel records, or follow-up requests; check export-control filings.

claims.label: Per Corby Hall Statement Host Reads, Marx Requested Long-Range Rifle to Execute Person Scaling Orphanage Fence
claims.claim: Per a written statement by Corby Hall that the host reads, in October 2024 Victor Marx requested a 1,000-yard capable rifle with scope camera, stating it would be used to "blow the head off" of anyone attempting to scale the fence of a Haiti orphanage, with video used as propaganda.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the build of the rifle, related communications, and any video documentation produced.

claims.label: Marx Stated Intent to Capture or Execute Jimmy Barbecue
claims.claim: Corby Hall's written statement documents that Victor Marx stated his team was going to capture or execute Jimmy Barbecue, then the top gang leader of Haiti.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with subsequent Haiti mission records and CBN News reporting.

claims.label: Marx Discussed Fold AR Acquisition with Sig Sauer / Daniel Horner
claims.claim: Corby Hall's written statement documents that Victor Marx stated he was discussing the acquisition of Fold AR with Sig Sauer, and that Sig Sauer's top shooter Daniel Horner had tested the Fold AR and given a "thumbs up."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify with Sig Sauer corporate communications and Daniel Horner directly.

claims.label: Per Corby Hall Statement Host Reads, Marx Valued Fold AR at $2 Million and Sought 51% Controlling Interest
claims.claim: Per a written statement by Corby Hall that the host reads, Victor Marx stated that his accountants valued Fold AR at $2 million (including the patent) and that he personally wanted to purchase 51% of the company.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify with any valuation documents, accountants, or formal acquisition proposals.

claims.label: Marx Stated IDF Needed 50,000 Guns for Gaza, Lebanon, Syria
claims.claim: Corby Hall's written statement documents that during a walk on his property, Victor Marx stated that the IDF needed 50,000 guns for operations in Gaza, Lebanon, and Syria.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify any related communications, broker contacts, or follow-up activity; cross-check with export-control records.

claims.label: Per Corby Hall Statement Host Reads, Marx Showed Hall Underground Bunker Under Construction at His Residence
claims.claim: Per a written statement by Corby Hall that the host reads, Victor Marx showed Hall a structure behind his house that included a large underground bunker, a front-facing firearm port, and an indoor shooting range, which Marx described as intended for "spiritual retooling" of officers working child sex trafficking cases.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the existence and current status of the structure via public records or satellite imagery.

claims.label: Marx Sent Group Message Calling Hall "Demonically Influenced"
claims.claim: Corby Hall's written statement documents that after the deal fell through, Victor Marx sent a group message to Hall and Melody stating Hall was "demonically influenced" because he refused a retooling prayer.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original message text if retained.

claims.label: Host Says Fold AR SN 02735 Was Sold to Texas Deputy on June 6, 2024
claims.claim: The host says, based on Corby Hall's account, that on June 6, 2024 Hall sold a Fold AR with serial number 02735 to a Texas deputy.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the sale via Fold AR's bound book / ATF Form 4473 records.

claims.label: Fold AR SN 02735 Reported Stolen from Texas Deputy's Vehicle July 4, 2024
claims.claim: The host says that on July 4, 2024, the Texas deputy contacted Corby Hall and told him that Fold AR SN 02735 was stolen from his car at a gas station in Midland, Texas after he accidentally left the doors and windows down, and that the deputy claimed he reported it to local Midland police.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify with Midland Police Department records and the deputy's agency.

claims.label: ATF Trace Initiated on Fold AR SN 02735 on September 10, 2025
claims.claim: Per host account of forwarded ATF email, on September 10, 2025, at 9:33 a.m. Central, Corby Hall received an email from the ATF initiating a trace on Fold AR SN 02735 with a 24-hour response window; the email is described as real and confirmed by the host.
claims.investigative_direction: Independently verify the email via ATF; identify the originating case and underlying crime.

claims.label: Erika Kirk and Eileen Marx Filmed Hugging After Assassination
claims.claim: An Instagram video shows Erika Kirk and Eileen Marx embracing shortly after Charlie Kirk's assassination, with impassioned music ("Held" by Natalie Grant) added, posted by Victor Marx.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original Instagram post metadata; verify posting timestamp.

claims.label: Host Shows Photo of Erika Kirk Being Comforted by Victor Marx at Residence
claims.claim: The host shows a photo that she says shows Erika Kirk being comforted by Victor Marx in the building she lives in, approximately 72 hours after Charlie Kirk's assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original image metadata; verify posting context.

claims.label: CBN News Reported Marx Visited Haiti and Met with Jimmy Barbecue
claims.claim: CBN News aired a report stating that after a visit from American missionary Victor Marx, Haitian gang leader Jimmy Barbecue (Cherizier) pledged to protect orphanages and Christian workers; in the report Marx says he prayed with him, and the report says the FAA banned US flights to Haiti after three planes were hit by gunfire.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with other reporting on Marx's Haiti activities and any FAA enforcement records.

claims.label: Trump Publicly Stated the US Sent Guns to Iranian Protesters
claims.claim: During a White House Easter celebration, Donald Trump publicly stated that the US had sent guns to Iranian protesters and expressed frustration that intermediaries had kept them rather than distributing them.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full transcript of the remarks; verify the operational chain Trump described.

claims.label: Marx Publicly Claimed He Killed a Man at Age 7 Under Coercion
claims.claim: In an audio clip the host plays, Victor Marx recounts that his stepfather placed a pistol in his hand, put his finger over Victor's trigger finger, and forced him to shoot a man in the head; the host says Marx was 7 at the time and that Marx says the body was later buried and he reported it to police 40 years later.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the source recording; verify any underlying events or absence thereof via law enforcement records.

claims.label: Viewer Asserts Marines Require Minimum 4-Year Enlistment
claims.claim: A viewer comment the host reads, from Wonder Woman, says "Marines only allow a minimum 4-year enlistment. 2 years is not possible."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Marine Corps enlistment contract minimums through official Marine Corps publications.

claims.label: Host Asserts 2-Year Enlistment Was Possible
claims.claim: The host states that she looked into the Marine enlistment question and confirms that a 2-year service is correct, disagreeing with the viewer's assertion.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the host's assertion against Marine Corps enlistment options.

claims.label: Host Concurs with Corby Hall's Testimony
claims.claim: The host explicitly states she believes Corby Hall's account, has confirmed the ATF email is real, and considers the timing of the ATF trace to be "odd" and "precise."
claims.investigative_direction: Independently verify the host's confirmation of the email and the underlying timeline.

claims.label: Host Says Turning Point Faith Was the Infiltration
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point Faith was the infiltration of Turning Point USA, that after Charlie met Erika the organization shifted from free markets and capitalism to being all about the church, and that she has said so repeatedly.
claims.investigative_direction: Trace when Turning Point Faith was launched, who funded and staffed it, and how TPUSA's stated programming changed after 2023.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point Faith was the infiltration. How many times have you heard me say that? Over and over again.

claims.label: Host Says Erika's September 12 Address Was Written by Blake Neff
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk's first public address on September 12 was not written by Erika and that she was told it was written by Blake Neff.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain drafts, document metadata or staff testimony on who wrote the September 12 address; ask Neff and TPUSA to confirm or deny.
claims.transcript_snippet: which was not written by her, I was told it was written by Blake Neff

claims.label: Host Quotes Erika Saying Charlie Witnessed for His Lord and Savior Jesus Christ
claims.claim: The host quotes Erika Kirk's September 12 address as saying Charlie "witnessed for his Lord and savior Jesus Christ," noting that the speech was reportedly not written by Erika and that people have observed she rarely says Jesus Christ.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against the video and official transcript of the September 12 address.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie witnesses for his Lord uh witnessed for his Lord and savior Jesus Christ.

claims.label: Host Quotes Erika at the Memorial Saying Charlie Saw His Savior in Heaven
claims.claim: The host quotes Erika Kirk at the memorial as saying that one moment Charlie was doing what he loved, he blinked and he saw his savior in heaven.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the quoted words against the official memorial video and transcript.
claims.transcript_snippet: One moment Charlie was doing what he loved. He blinked and he saw his savior in heaven.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Did Not Eulogize Her Own Husband and Blake Neff Gave a Heavy Assist
claims.claim: The host says that, as she is told, Erika did not write her own memorial remarks and that Blake Neff came in with a heavy assist.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the host's sources and obtain drafts or staff accounts of who wrote the memorial remarks.
claims.transcript_snippet: Uh Blake Neff came in with a heavy assist.

claims.label: Host Says Justin Streiff Did Not Write His Own Memorial Speech
claims.claim: The host says she is told that Justin Streiff did not write his own speech for the memorial.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the speech drafts or ask the speechwriting staff who wrote Streiff's remarks.
claims.transcript_snippet: Justin Streiff did not write his own speech for the memorial, I'm told.

claims.label: Host Says She Spent Months on an Egyptian Plane Timeline
claims.claim: The host says she has spent months quietly working on an Egyptian plane timeline that grew from one plane to four.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's published spreadsheet of tail numbers and dates against ADS-B and FAA records.
claims.transcript_snippet: for months I have just been quietly working on my Egyptian plane timeline. Started with one plane, then I realized there was two planes, three planes, four planes.

claims.label: Host Says the Plane Pattern Looked Like Drug or Weapons Trafficking
claims.claim: The host says the pattern in the plane timeline struck her as possible trafficking, whether drugs or weapons, and she asks whether product is moving into or out of the United States.
claims.investigative_direction: Check customs and cargo records for the flights in question; the host states this only as an instinct.
claims.transcript_snippet: Why do I feel like I'm I'm looking at trafficking of some description? I don't know if it's drugs, I don't know if it's weapons

claims.label: Host Says the Planes Stopped Over States and Cities With Military Bases
claims.claim: The host says the Egyptian planes were foremost stopping over in states and cities with military bases.
claims.investigative_direction: Map each landing airport against nearby military installations using the flight logs.
claims.transcript_snippet: how the planes foremost were stopping over in states and cities with military bases.

claims.label: Host Says Planes Tracked Turning Point Faith Events From 2023 and Charlie's Schedule Mirrored Them From January 2024
claims.claim: The host says that after Mikey McCoy became chief of staff in January 2024, Charlie's schedule began to mirror the Egyptian planes, and that before that the planes seemed to track Turning Point Faith events from 2023.
claims.investigative_direction: Overlay Charlie Kirk's 2023 and 2024 event calendar on the Egyptian plane landing dates and cities.
claims.transcript_snippet: after Mikey McCoy becomes the chief of staff in January of 2024, uh Ch- Charlie suddenly his schedule is beginning to mirror these Egyptian planes.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Was Often in Kansas, Nebraska and Missouri Crossing With the Planes
claims.claim: The host says that once McCoy was announced as chief of staff, Charlie was doing a lot of events in Kansas, Nebraska and Missouri that crossed with the planes.
claims.investigative_direction: List Charlie's Kansas, Nebraska and Missouri appearances in 2024 and match them to plane arrival dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie is just doing a lot in Kansas and in Nebraska and in Missouri crossing with these planes.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Showed No Concern About Two Foreign Planes Around the Assassination
claims.claim: The host says Erika had no reaction, concern or even mild interest in two foreign planes that departed just before and just after her husband's assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect Erika's public statements and any on-air remarks about the planes; this rests on the host's reading of her reaction.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika had the complete wrong reaction, or rather no reaction or concern or even mild interest in a foreign plane, two foreign planes that departed just before and just after her husband's assassination.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Joked About the Egyptian Planes and Does Not Want Them Examined
claims.claim: The host says Erika, instead of calling Joe Kent to ask who was on the planes, made jokes about the Egyptian planes and does not want the public looking at them.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the specific Erika remarks the host calls jokes and check them for context.
claims.transcript_snippet: She wanted to make jokes about the Egyptian planes. She doesn't want the public looking at the Egyptian planes.

claims.label: Host Says Corby Hall Contacted Her Team Afraid for His Life
claims.claim: The host says her team was contacted by a man who said he was afraid for his life but felt he had to tell the truth for Charlie, and that after a phone call she is certain he was not being dramatic.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original email and call record from the host's team, and Hall's own account of what he fears.
claims.transcript_snippet: we were contacted by someone who said that he was afraid for his life, but that he felt that he had to speak out and tell the truth um for Charlie.

claims.label: Host Says Victor Marx Announced His Run for Colorado Governor at a Charlie Kirk Memorial Event
claims.claim: The host says Victor Marx, a Marine veteran, announced his run for governor of Colorado at a Charlie Kirk memorial event in Denver on September 14, saying the weight of the assassination showed God was calling him to run.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Colorado candidate filings and the event's video for the date and wording of the announcement.
claims.transcript_snippet: he chose to make to announce his intention to run for governor of Colorado at a Charlie Kirk memorial event in Denver on September 14th, just a couple of days after Charlie was assassinated.

claims.label: Host Says Marx Teaches a Turning Point Faith Course Called Freedom from Pornography
claims.claim: The host says Victor Marx teaches an online educational course for Turning Point Faith entitled Freedom from Pornography.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Turning Point Faith course catalog and instructor list for the course and its dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: he teaches an online educational course for Turning Point Faith entitled Freedom from Pornography.

claims.label: Host Says Marx Claims His 20-Year-Old Son Was Charlie's Assistant
claims.claim: The host says Victor Marx claims his 20-year-old son was at one point Charlie Kirk's assistant who spent much time with Erika and her first baby girl.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Marx's original statement and ask TPUSA whether any such assistant was employed.
claims.transcript_snippet: He also claims his 20-year-old son was at one point Charlie Kirk's assistant

claims.label: Host Says She Could Not Confirm Marx's Son Was Charlie's Assistant
claims.claim: The host says her team has been unable to confirm that Marx's son was Charlie's assistant and that she does not remember him in that role.
claims.investigative_direction: Check TPUSA staff rosters and Charlie's travel party lists for the person in question.
claims.transcript_snippet: we've been able unable to confirm that he was Charlie's assistant. I certainly don't remember him being Charlie's assistant

claims.label: Host Says Victor and Eileen Marx Were Among the First to Greet Erika With Cameras Rolling
claims.claim: The host says Victor Marx and his wife Eileen were among the very first people to see and greet Erika in the days after the assassination, comforting her with cameras rolling, and that this was less than 48 hours afterward (the host later puts one photo at about 72 hours).
claims.investigative_direction: Establish the date and location of the first Marx visit from the Instagram post metadata and the people who accompanied them.
claims.transcript_snippet: Pastor Victor Marx and his wife Eileen Marx were one of the very first people to go see and greet Erika in the days following Charlie's assassination.

claims.label: Host Notes Erika Holds a Phone in the Hug Video Though She Said Her Phone Stayed Off for Weeks
claims.claim: The host says that in the hug video Erika has her phone in her hand, the one she allegedly did not turn on for weeks after Charlie died.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the video date with Erika's statement about her phone and check whether the object in her hand is a phone.
claims.transcript_snippet: you may have also noted that Erika has her phone in her hand, the one that she allegedly did not turn on for weeks after Charlie died.

claims.label: Host Says Marx Was Allegedly Interested in Trafficking Arms to Haiti and Contacted Corby Hall
claims.claim: The host says Victor Marx, like his stepfather, was allegedly interested in trafficking, particularly arms to Haiti, and contacted Corby Hall to get this done.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek export-control filings or communications; Marx has denied this in a later episode, which this note does not rely on.
claims.transcript_snippet: Victor, like his stepdaddy, was allegedly interested in trafficking, particularly arms over to Haiti, and he contacted a man named Corby Hall to get this done.

claims.label: Host Says Marx's Real Name Is Vaughn Victor Kennedy
claims.claim: The host says Victor Marx's real name is Vaughn Victor Kennedy, that he says Vaughn while his military record says Vo with no N.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Marx's military service record (DD-214) and any name-change filing.
claims.transcript_snippet: his real name is Vaughn Victor Kennedy. Well, he says it's Vaughn.

claims.label: Host Says Marx Had Lived in 17 Homes and Attended 14 Schools by Age 17
claims.claim: The host says that by age 17 Marx had lived in 17 homes and attended 14 schools and was involved with drugs, fights and theft in high school.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Marx's own published memoir or interviews for these figures.
claims.transcript_snippet: by the time he was 17, he had lived in 17 homes and attended 14 schools.

claims.label: Host Says Marx's Stepfather Gloyce Kennedy Was Army Counterintelligence Then Ran a Jamaica Drug Ring
claims.claim: The host says Marx's stepfather, Gloyce Dean Kennedy, whom Marx calls Mr. K, served in the army doing counterintelligence and afterwards ran an international drug smuggling ring out of Jamaica.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the army service record and the federal case file for Gloyce Dean Kennedy.
claims.transcript_snippet: his stepfather served in the army and did counterintelligence. And thereafter, he ran an international drug smuggling ring out of Jamaica

claims.label: Host Says Gloyce Kennedy Was Convicted in 1987 and Sentenced to 14 Years
claims.claim: The host says Gloyce Dean Kennedy pled guilty and was convicted of conspiracy in 1987 for attempting to import 1,400 lb of marijuana from Jamaica, with money laundering and aiding and abetting charges, and was sentenced to 14 years in prison.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the 1987 federal docket and sentencing record by name.
claims.transcript_snippet: convicted of conspiracy in 1987 for attempting to import 1,400 lb of marijuana from Jamaica.

claims.label: Host Says Marx's Brother Mike Kennedy Took a Plea Deal and Testified Against Their Stepfather
claims.claim: The host says Marx's brother Mike Kennedy, later an attorney, pled guilty as co-conspirator in the smuggling ring and served only a year and a day in exchange for testifying against his stepfather Gloyce.
